profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a public company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and trades under the ticker CLS. According to its own website, it describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, and manufacturing, working across what it calls high-growth markets. The company says it engineers, designs, and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. It also cites supply chain and platform solutions among its capabilities and describes a global network supporting its customers.

The company's site presents its AI work as infrastructure rather than end-user products, framing data center hardware for AI and cloud as its main area of activity. Beyond that positioning, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001030894 and a for-profit public company structure.
